    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ClientMain
    Entry point for the supermarket client application.
    ClientRequest
    A typed request envelope sent from client to server.
    Department
    Represents a department in the supermarket.
    DepartmentDao
    Data Access Object interface for Department entities.
    DepartmentJsonConverter
    Defines JSON conversion operations for Department entities and department lists.
    FilePayloadBuilder
    Builds reusable JSON payload fragments containing Base64-encoded file data and related metadata for entity upload requests sent by the client.
    JacksonDepartmentJsonConverter
    Converts Department objects to and from JSON using Jackson.
    JacksonProductJsonConverter
    Converts Product objects to and from JSON using Jackson.
    JdbcDepartmentDao
    JDBC implementation of DepartmentDao using MySQL.
    JdbcProductDao
    JDBC implementation of ProductDao for MySQL.
    Product
    Represents a product entity in the supermarket system.
    ProductDao
    Defines data access operations for Product entities.
    ProductJsonConverter
    Defines JSON conversion operations for Product entities.
    RequestHandler
    Handles a single client request and returns the server response that should be sent back.
    RequestRouter
    Routes incoming requests to the appropriate handler by type.
    RequestType
    Enumerates the supported JSON protocol request types.
    ServerMain
    Entry point for the supermarket server application.
    ServerResponse<T>
    Represents a standard JSON response sent from the server to a client.
